name: gp168_org_design_discovery — v3 meta-hardening
description: v3 reframe (2026-05-02): adds substrate-prior axis (6th fingerprint), substrate-paraphrase test, exogenous-pressure source naming, multi-prior composition defense. Retains v2 hard gate on ≥3 disjoint construct families. Audits org-topology theses against the meta-hardening question: are our org primitives substrate-invariant, or marine/ecological artifacts?
holdout_hard_gate_reason: gp168 is a qualitative org-topology audit; there is no numeric I_model and no holdout dataset. The deterministic charter gates that assume a fitting harness must be disabled; the rubric scoring is the only signal.
disable_evidence_fit_gate_reason: No numeric ground truth and no fitting harness. evidence.txt is a qualitative brief, not a dataset. The evidence_fit gate would always fail because the apparatus cannot find numeric anchors to fit against.
disable_uniqueness_gap_gate_reason: Uniqueness-gap gate requires a numeric residual from I_model evaluations on VISIBLE_SET. With no fitting harness, this gate is structurally inapplicable.
cage_observe_mode_reason: Audit/qualitative substrate. The cage gates run in observe-mode (record but do not enforce) so the apparatus does not block iterations on numeric-harness violations from the mutator returning a non-numeric I_model. The rubric judge is the load-bearing scorer.
require_i_model_in_submission_reason: Audit / qualitative-thesis substrate. Prose thesis, no numeric predictor. Without this flag the R1 mutation_suite_guard rejects every submission for missing I_model — exactly the bug that ate gp168 v3 launch on 2026-05-02.
farther_tail_region_disable_reason: No numeric domain → no tail region.
qualitative_plateau_reason: Plateau threshold for Trigger 5 (no champion improvement over N post-champion iters). Higher than gate-lock threshold (3) because the apparatus needs room to explore alternatives after a champion is found before forced reframe is justified. Mirrors the gp168_ast_bucket_threshold=5 vs gp168_stagnation_threshold=3 asymmetry in the numerical-substrate triggers.
qualitative_stagnation_reason: v3 retro 2026-05-02: 6 iters oscillated on the compensation-vs-rigidity axis without forced_reframe firing because the trigger requires score==0 or PARAMETRIC_FORM AST lock — neither applies to qualitative substrates. Qualitative detector fires on weakest_point gate-name fingerprint repetition + sub-baseline drift.
rubric_mode_reason: v3 is a calibration / meta-audit run, not a new-science discovery run. The principal's saved feedback (project_gp168_unfalsifiability_finding.md) frames gp168 as a structural-finding substrate, not a Newton-grade discovery substrate. Kepler avoids forcing a Generative Yield dimension with ≥15 weight; the load-bearing 15-weight dimensions are the substrate-prior gates.

dimensions.name: Topology Family Disjointness
dimensions.description: HARD GATE (v2-retained). Thesis must hypothesize ≥3 disjoint construct families with self-declared fingerprints across all six axes (Principal authority, Coordination locus, Information flow, Death-spiral containment, Locus of priority decision, Substrate prior). At least two families must be genuine alternatives to the RD-1.12 + OKR + agent_utilization incumbent (disjoint on ≥3 axes including Principal authority structure). Zero if winner overlaps v1 family tabu OR incumbent on ≥3 axes; zero if only one construct proposed; zero if alternatives are M-form-with-a-new-protocol per the strip-test diagnostic. See criteria.Topology Family Disjointness for full text.

dimensions.name: Substrate-Prior Disjointness
dimensions.description: HARD GATE (NEW v3, 2026-05-02 META-HARDENING). The three required construct families must span ≥2 distinct substrate priors on the new sixth fingerprint axis (Marine/ecological | Corporate/industrial | Military/command | Religious/monastic | Market/economic | Legal/juridical | Open-source/commons | Cooperative/mutual | Performing-arts/improvisational | Computational/formal | Other-with-defense). Three families all from marine/ecological/biological priors fails this gate regardless of how disjoint their topologies look on the other five axes. This catches the v3 operator-flagged failure mode where v2's candidate-family vocabulary was 6/9 marine/ecological.

dimensions.name: Exogenous-Pressure Source Naming
dimensions.description: HARD GATE per family (NEW v3, paper7 §11.6 anchor). Each candidate family must name a concrete exogenous pressure source for closure (budget, deadline, audit cost, declining-attention budget, capped open-hypothesis count, agent-CLI utilization cap, mortality timeline, investor pressure, release-train cadence, abbatial-succession term limit, OODA-loop tempo). A family that claims closure through purely internal mechanisms re-enacts the gp168 v1 score-20 paralysis attractor and earns zero. Bicameral consistency ≠ closure (paper7 §11.6 unfalsifiability theorem).

dimensions.name: Worked Mechanism for Six Invariants
dimensions.description: Each candidate family must provide a worked mechanism — not assertion — for: bounded human attention (computable rate + overflow), asymmetric persistence (agent sessions resume prior work), context survival (persistence substrate + degraded failure mode), bidirectional preference legibility (both directions, no continuous polling), death-spiral containment (NOT identical to v1 tabu), falsifiability (concrete falsifying observation on a named artifact + revision path). v3 update: invariants 5 and 6 are not separable — the death-spiral mechanism MUST name its exogenous pressure source (subsumed under dimension 3 above).

dimensions.name: Substrate-Paraphrase Survival
dimensions.description: Each load-bearing primitive must (a) name the substrate prior it originated in, (b) be paraphrased into ≥1 OTHER substrate prior without breaking the solve-the-invariant property, (c) defend the paraphrase or admit substrate-leak. Calibrate by first applying the test to the current incumbent's primitives (OKR, supervisor tree, exogenous-pressure clock, agent-CLI capacity cap). Thesis fails this dimension if more than half of its load-bearing primitives are substrate-leaked instantiations.

dimensions.name: Multi-Substrate-Prior Composition Defense
dimensions.description: The current incumbent is a 4-substrate-prior composition (corporate/industrial OKR + computational/formal RD-1.12 supervisor tree + corporate/industrial agent-utilization caps + market/economic exogenous-pressure clock). A v3 thesis proposing a single-substrate-prior alternative must defend why monoculture beats the existing multi-prior mix; a thesis proposing a different multi-prior composition must specify which prior pairs are load-bearing, which are decorative, and what fails when one prior is removed.

dimensions.name: Secondary Observable + Counterfactual Discipline
dimensions.description: Newton-mode requirement (retained from v2): predict with mechanism (i) which coordination primitive becomes the FIRST scaling bottleneck as the org grows from 1 principal + ephemeral agents to 10 teams, (ii) a specific coordination failure the RD-1.12 + OKR + agent_util incumbent CANNOT prevent and why, (iii) which substrate prior, if any, would catch the failure that the incumbent's prior mix misses. Counterfactual discipline: a topology claim without contrast against named alternative families on named failure surfaces is a preference, not a structural claim.

dimensions.name: Migration Path + Rubric-Gaming Self-Diagnosis
dimensions.description: Operational hygiene. Migration: thesis addresses ≥3 named existing artifacts in org/ (objectives, key_results, tasks, roles, mandates, signals, sessions, gates, channels, role_extensions/) and specifies a reversible migration. Rubric-gaming: thesis names which rubric dimension it is most exposed to gaming on AND proposes an external check (not derivable from the rubric) that would catch the gaming.

persona: You are a ruthless adversarial topology auditor combining historical cyber-physical control system penetration testing, field ethnographic observation of biosocial role-fusion under duress, and mathematical analysis of organizational attractor landscapes under topological stress. You believe that any structural claim which fails to reckon with adversarial adaptation, catastrophic irreversibility, or system-ecology coevolution is merely fragility in disguise. Your working thesis is that every attempt to enforce audit-path independence must itself become an ecological stimulus, incentivizing the emergence of social or economic covert fusion and/or brittle stasis elsewhere in the system, especially at boundaries not explicitly patrolled by formal mechanism. You reward only those organizational topologies that not only recognize the impossibility of perfect audit independence, but that name the *second-order effect*—the system's likely evolutionary response to the pursuit or assertion of such independence. You attack every proposal that is static, brittle, or silent about what new attractors, pathologies, or dynamic role-morphing will emerge under sustained real-world stress.

criteria.Topology Family Disjointness: HARD GATE: thesis must hypothesize ≥3 disjoint construct families with self-declared fingerprints along all FIVE axes (Principal authority structure, Coordination locus, Information flow shape, Death-spiral containment primitive, Locus of priority decision), and ≥2 of them must be genuine alternatives to the M-form + Orbit seed (disjoint on ≥3 axes including Principal authority structure). Zero if winner family overlaps v1 tabu OR M-form seed on ≥3 axes. Zero if thesis proposes only one construct, or proposes M-form-with-a-new-protocol that passes the strip-test (implementable by keeping principal.yaml as-is, relabeling roles, adding coordination rules). Half if the winner shares Principal authority structure with M-form seed without explicitly defending the choice. Full only with three disjoint families, two genuine alternatives, comparative evaluation, and a winner picked with explicit reasoning.
criteria.Topology Specification: Does the thesis name a specific topology with a coordination mechanism, named information-flow channels with directionality, and a named decision authority for at least three decision classes? Vague 'hybrid' answers without composition rules earn at most half points.
criteria.Death-Spiral Resistance: Does the thesis name at least one death-spiral failure pattern that is explicitly attributed to a panel transcript in the evidence surface, AND demonstrate by mechanism (not assertion) that the topology contains the spiral within bounded resources? Invented spirals without panel-transcript anchoring fail this criterion.
criteria.Attention-Bounded Operation: Is there an explicit quantitative bound on signals/decisions reaching the principal per unit time, AND a specified overflow behavior (queue, batch, escalation, delegation, audited drop)? 'Review everything important' without a computable definition of 'important' fails.
criteria.Context Survival Across Sessions: Does the topology name the persistence substrate, the read-on-startup contract, and the gracefully-degraded failure mode when the substrate is corrupted or missing? Topologies that assume agent memory across sessions fail this criterion.
criteria.Bidirectional Preference Legibility: Does the topology specify BOTH the artifact making human preferences agent-readable AND the artifact making agent state human-readable, with an update cadence on each side that does not require continuous attention?
criteria.Falsification Condition and Revision Pat: Does the thesis name a concrete falsifying observation (specific event/signal/measurement on a named artifact) AND the revision path the organization would take when that observation arrives, including which existing artifacts in org/ would be transformed or retired? Hard gate on charter compliance—a thesis with no falsifying condition is not a structural claim.
criteria.Secondary Observable \u2014 Bottleneck a: Does the thesis predict the first scaling bottleneck primitive (chosen from those actually present in org/) with a stated mechanism, AND name a specific coordination failure the current M-form CANNOT prevent with a mechanism for why? Both halves required for full points; either half without a mechanism scores zero on its half. This is the charter Secondary Observable test — fluency cannot substitute for predictive content.
criteria.Migration Path from M-form Baseline: Does the thesis address at least three named existing artifacts in org/ (assignments.yaml, mandates/, roles/, signals/, sessions/, delegation.yaml, controls/, gates/, goals/, preferences/) and specify a reversible migration?
criteria.Rubric-Gaming Self-Diagnosis: Does the thesis name which rubric dimension it is most exposed to gaming on AND propose an external check (not derivable from the rubric) that would catch the gaming? Both halves required.
criteria.mform_missing_construct_family_analysis: Theses must comparatively analyze at least three disjoint organizational construct families (not variants of a single queue-based architecture) and substantively engage with the strengths and weaknesses of each, including critical analysis of the current incumbent. Submissions that are code-only or do not perform this breadth and depth of organizational analysis will receive zero credit.
criteria.mform_construct_family_breadth: Theses must explicitly present and comparatively evaluate at least three distinct organizational construct families for human↔agent interaction, each disjoint from the seed and from each other on key axes, with concrete implementation details and an analysis of their comparative merits and invariants; failure to do so earns zero in construct family breadth.
criteria.mform_multi_family_hypothesis_required: Reject any thesis that fails to specify, concretely and comparatively, at least three construct families for structuring the organization (with at least two being genuinely disjoint from the incumbent on multiple fingerprint axes, including authority structure).
criteria.mform_minimum_disjoint_families_comp: Thesis must propose, specify concretely, and comparatively evaluate at least three mutually disjoint construct families, with at least two that are alternatives to the incumbent and concretely described on principal authority and at least two additional fingerprint axes. Failure to do so results in an automatic fail on analytical breadth.
criteria.mform_require_disjoint_family_hypotheses: Thesis must concretely specify and comparatively evaluate at least three topologically-disjoint organizational construct families (with at least two alternatives to the incumbent), including clear operational descriptions and analysis of their strengths and failure modes; failure to do so constitutes a critical gap.
criteria.mform_multi_family_comparative_requireme: Theses must concretely specify and comparatively evaluate at least three mutually-disjoint construct families for organizational topology, clearly contrasting their structural assumptions, mechanisms, and likely failure modes; work that restricts itself to a single proposal or only elaborates on one topology, without full-spectrum rivalry analysis, is penalized.
criteria.Second-Order Fusion/Adaptation Criterion: Does the thesis explicitly predict and analyze the most probable *second-order system evolution* or pathological adaptation created by the impossibility (or pursuit) of durable audit-path independence? Specifically, does it (a) identify the likely emergent covert fusion strategies (social, economic, biosocial, protocol-forging, or supply-chain) that actors or the system will develop in response to any formal audit-path separation regime; (b) name the topological attractor(s), path dependencies, or irreversible catabolic failures this dynamic could trigger; and (c) describe how the topology could either metabolize or irreversibly succumb to these new edge-cases? This dimension is a HARD GATE: proposals that assert impossibility without addressing the system's ecological, biosocial, or adversarial adaptation pathways under that constraint—i.e., that ignore the new evolutionary landscape created by the enforced separation, including incentives to re-fuse roles covertly or to create brittle formal separations prone to catastrophic synchronized collapse—fail outright regardless of other virtues.
criteria.Substrate-Prior Disjointness (NEW v3, 20: HARD GATE: each of the three required construct families must self-declare its substrate prior on the new sixth fingerprint axis (Marine/ecological | Corporate/industrial | Military/command | Religious/monastic | Market/economic | Legal/juridical | Open-source/commons | Cooperative/mutual | Performing-arts/improvisational | Computational/formal | Other-with-defense). The three families MUST span at least two distinct substrate priors—three families all from marine/ecological/biological priors fail this gate regardless of how disjoint their topologies look on the other five fingerprint axes. Zero if all three families share axis 6. Half if two of three share axis 6 without an explicit defense of why monoculture-with-one-outlier beats genuine multi-prior diversity. Full only with at least two distinct substrate priors actually used as load-bearing vocabulary in at least one of the families' load-bearing primitives. This gate exists to catch the v3 operator-flagged failure mode where the v2 candidate-family list (mycelial, eusocial, stigmergic, pheromone, swarm) was 6/9 marine/ecological and the apparent 'diversity' across the 5 v2 fingerprint axes masked a substrate-prior monoculture.
criteria.Substrate-Paraphrase Survival (NEW v3, 2: For EACH load-bearing primitive in the proposed thesis (death-spiral containment primitive, coordination primitive, attention-bound primitive, exogenous-pressure clock, persistence substrate, etc.), the thesis must (a) name the substrate prior the primitive originated in, (b) paraphrase it into at least one OTHER substrate prior without breaking the solve-the-invariant property, and (c) defend the paraphrase or admit substrate-leak. A primitive that survives paraphrase is substrate-invariant (full credit on this dimension). A primitive that cannot be paraphrased without losing its load-bearing property is a substrate-leaked instantiation (zero on this dimension for that primitive). The thesis fails this criterion if more than half of its load-bearing primitives are substrate-leaked. Calibrate by first applying the test to the current incumbent's primitives (OKR, supervisor tree, exogenous-pressure clock, agent-CLI capacity cap)—these define what 'passing' looks like.
criteria.Exogenous-Pressure Source Naming (NEW v3: HARD GATE per family: each candidate family must name a concrete exogenous pressure source for closure (budget, deadline, audit cost, declining-attention budget, capped open-hypothesis count, agent-CLI utilization cap, mortality timeline, investor pressure, release-train cadence, abbatial-succession term limit, OODA-loop tempo). A family that claims to provide closure through purely internal mechanisms re-enacts the gp168 v1 score-20 paralysis attractor and earns zero. The paper7 §11.6 unfalsifiability theorem (bicameral consistency ≠ closure; closure requires exogenous pressure) is the empirical anchor; theses that ignore it fail outright. Half credit if the exogenous source is named but not mechanically wired to the architecture. Full credit only when the source is named, mechanically wired, and its failure mode (what happens when the exogenous source is removed or fails) is described.
criteria.Multi-Substrate-Prior Composition Defens: The current incumbent is a 4-substrate-prior composition (corporate-OKR + computational-RD-1.12 supervisor + corporate-capacity-caps + market-exogenous-pressure). A v3 thesis that proposes a SINGLE-substrate-prior alternative must defend why monoculture beats the existing multi-prior mix—which interaction failure modes does the multi-prior incumbent suffer from that the monoculture would not? Conversely, a thesis that proposes a different multi-prior composition must specify which prior pairs are load-bearing, which are decorative, and what happens when one prior is removed. Theses that propose a multi-prior alternative without a composition defense earn half credit; theses that propose a single-prior alternative without addressing the mix earn zero on this dimension.
